youtube_description:
Jesus's Replies — an imagined reply from Jesus, answered from Scripture.

Prayer for faith on the night shift.

She: Jesus... I've missed every Sunday this month. 🌙
She: Night shift. I sleep through the service and watch the livestream at 2am like a rerun.
Jesus: I don't keep office hours. I was there at 3am when the monitor alarmed.
She: But it says don't stop meeting. I feel like I'm drifting.
Jesus: Find one believer on your shift and pray together. Two is the smallest church there is.
Jesus: Come back when the rota frees. I'm not counting Sundays. I'm counting you.
Jesus: Which Sunday will you make it back? 👇

“Let us not neglect meeting together, as some have made a habit, but let us encourage one another, and all the more as you see the Day approaching.”
Hebrews 10:25 (BSB)
